title: Add the create-item endpoint
goal: Add validate.js exporting validName(value): true only for a string whose trimmed text is 1 to 20 characters. Add endpoint.js exporting createItem(body): return { status: 400, body: { error: "invalid name" } } when the body or its name is missing or invalid, otherwise { status: 201, body: { name: <the trimmed name> } }. A missing or null body never throws.
